# Django LMS

*Client industry: education | Completed: 2024-01-19 | Evidence id: fullstack:case:p04*

## The problem
The client was a tutoring academy emailing PDFs to students.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using Django, a relational database with proper migrations, Celery, containerised deployment. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project served 3,000 students with automated grading reminders.
